resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and German source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded German pass identified 25 actionable defects in electrical, circuit, thermal, trigonometric, and unit terminology; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent German human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The current definition repeated the German word for ampere.
evidence: The previous text said ‘Ampere oder Ampere’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise ‘gemessen in Ampere (A)’.

findings.summary: Electrical power was translated as electrical energy.
evidence: The section formula and text describe Leistung P, not energy.
findings.resolution: Changed the title to ‘Elektrische Leistung’.

findings.summary: The summary said current transforms resistance into heat.
evidence: The physical quantity transformed into heat is electrical energy.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it as current converting electrical energy into heat.

findings.summary: The conservation description lacked a clear object and loop wording.
evidence: The previous text said ‘Erhaltung an Schaltungsknoten’ in an incomplete construction.
findings.resolution: Clarified conservation at circuit nodes and in closed loops.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms title used the wrong technical noun.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Schaltungsbedingungen’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Schaltungsbegriffe’.

findings.summary: The introductory sentence used an awkward literal idiom.
evidence: The previous wording said the concepts made it easier to think about a diagram.
findings.resolution: Changed it to say the concepts make a schematic easier to understand.

findings.summary: A branch was translated as an ‘aktueller’ path rather than a current path.
evidence: ‘Aktuell’ means current in time, not electric current.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Strompfad’.

findings.summary: Kirchhoff's current law used the false cognate ‘aktuelles Gesetz’.
evidence: The title used ‘aktuell’ instead of the electrical-current term ‘Strom’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Kirchhoffs Stromgesetz’.

findings.summary: The current-law paragraph used the wrong term for current direction and capitalized a sentence fragment.
evidence: The previous text said ‘aktuelle Richtung’ and ‘Ein negatives’ mid-sentence.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it using ‘Stromrichtung’ and normal German sentence casing.

findings.summary: A closed loop was translated as a regulatory circuit.
evidence: The previous text used ‘geschlossenen Regelkreis’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a closed electrical loop.

findings.summary: The TCR example title used an unnatural literal adjective.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Ein hitziger Widerstand’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Widerstand bei hoher Temperatur’.

findings.summary: The TCR unit was corrupted in the German setup sentence.
evidence: The previous text displayed ‘ppm/ü’ instead of ppm/°C.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected temperature unit ppm/°C.

findings.summary: The sine formula used ‘Gegenteil’ instead of the German geometry term Gegenkathete.
evidence: The previous formula read ‘sin = Gegenteil / Hypotenuse’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Gegenkathete / Hypotenuse’.

findings.summary: The tangent formula mixed imprecise opposite and adjacent terms.
evidence: The previous formula used ‘gegenüber / angrenzend’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the standard German Gegenkathete / Ankathete terms.

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula contained a typo in Ankathete.
evidence: The previous expression used ‘Antenkathete’.
findings.resolution: Corrected the formula to ‘Ankathete / Hypotenuse’.

findings.summary: The full-cycle statement omitted the word Bogenmaß after 2π.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with ‘2π im Bogenmaß’ without the unit noun.
findings.resolution: Clarified that a full cycle is 2π im Bogenmaß.

findings.summary: The water example title was an unnatural compound.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Heizungswasser’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Wasser erwärmen’.

findings.summary: The electrical-heating title used a general heating noun.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Heizung mit Strom’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Elektrische Erwärmung’.

findings.summary: The German conclusion capitalized a new clause after a semicolon.
evidence: The previous text used ‘; Eine echte Heizung’.
findings.resolution: Changed the clause to normal German lowercase after the semicolon.

findings.summary: The heat-flux unit was translated as heat flow rather than heat-flux density.
evidence: The source quantity q'' is flux per area, not total heat flow.
findings.resolution: Changed the label to Wärmestromdichte.

findings.summary: The final heat-flux check used an infinitive instead of an imperative.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with ‘Wärmekapazität zur Temperaturänderung nutzen’.
findings.resolution: Rephrased it with the formal imperative ‘nutzen Sie’.

findings.summary: The mass row was translated as ‘Messe’.
evidence: ‘Messe’ means a fair or mass, not physical mass as a quantity label.
findings.resolution: Changed the row to ‘Masse’.

findings.summary: The time unit was translated as the ordinal ‘zweitens’.
evidence: The previous row used ‘zweitens’ instead of ‘Sekunde’.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit name to ‘Sekunde’.

findings.summary: The amount-of-substance row used ‘Maulwurf’ and the wrong quantity label.
evidence: ‘Maulwurf’ means mole as an animal; the SI quantity is Stoffmenge with unit Mol.
findings.resolution: Changed the row to Stoffmenge and Mol.

findings.summary: The candela symbol used uppercase CD.
evidence: The SI symbol for candela is lowercase cd.
findings.resolution: Corrected the protected SI symbol to cd.
